css: .section.is-alt { background-color: #e8e1d5; } .grid-3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; grid-column-gap: 32px; grid-row-gap: 48px; } .stack-s { display: flex; flex-direction: column; grid-row-gap: 12px; } .stack-m { display: flex; flex-direction: column; grid-row-gap: 24px; } .heading-l { font-family: "Instrument Serif", serif; font-weight: 400; color: #141613; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-size: 68px; line-height: 1.0; } .heading-s { font-family: "Instrument Serif", serif; font-weight: 400; color: #141613; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-size: 28px; line-height: 1.15; } .small { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; } .muted { color: #85867f; } .category-card { text-decoration: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; grid-row-gap: 20px; color: #141613; } .category-image-wrap { border-radius: 28px; overflow: hidden; height: 460px; position: relative; } .category-image { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 800ms ease; } .category-count { position: absolute; left: 20px; top: 20px; background-color: rgba(242, 237, 228, 0.92); color: #141613; border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 14px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; } .category-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .circle-arrow { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #141613; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 18px; transition: background-color 300ms ease, color 300ms ease; flex: none; } @media screen and (max-width: 991px) { .heading-l { font-size: 54px; } .grid-3 { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } .category-image-wrap { height: 380px; } } @media screen and (max-width: 767px) { .heading-l { font-size: 42px; } .grid-3 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } } @media screen and (max-width: 479px) { .heading-l { font-size: 36px; } }
